newsitem.title: USA: Sparta Foods gets tortilla supply pacts.
newsitem.headline: Sparta Foods gets tortilla supply pacts.

text.p: Sparta Foods Inc said Monday it was chosen as a supplier of tortillas to Perkins Family Restaurants LP and to Friendly's Ice Cream Corp.
Perkins operates and franchises over 400 restaurants nationwide. Friendly's has more than 700 restaurants in 15 states. The value of the supply agreements was not given.

"This new business, along with our expectations for continued strong growth in retail sales from our primary tortilla distributors, Crystal Farms Refrigerated Distribution Co and Marigold Foods Inc, have created the need to add to our manufacturing capacity," Joel Bachul, president, said in a statement.
Sparta said it plans to relocate its corporate headquarters and manufacturing operations to New Brighton, Minn., from its present location in St. Paul.
The company said it has signed a letter of intent with First Industrial Realty Trust Inc for a 15-year lease of approximately 112,000 square feet in New Brighton.
Sparta Foods produces and distributes tortillas and value-added tortilla products to the food service and retail foods industries.
